description: Removes one plain-English scheduling rule (ruleId, from add_staff_scheduling_rule or read staff_scheduling_rules) from a field worker (staff_id), as remove on their Rules tab does. Answers the rules left. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.

name: remove_staff_scheduling_rule
title: Remove a field worker's scheduling rule
